The USDA reported a private export sale of 111,000 MT of soybeans for 2026/27 to China this morning. China’s President Xi will be in the US next week to meet with President Trump, with trade a topic of conversation. Secretary Bessent headed to China for this weekend to set up talks for next week.

USDA’s Export Sales report took the current marketing year sale commitments for corn to 20.631 MMT, more than double the same week last year. That is already 45% of the USDA export projection and ahead of the 36% average over the last 5 years.
Sinograin, China’s state stockpiler, is set to auction off 543,000 MT of imported beans next Tuesday.
Nov 26 Soybeans  closed at $13.03 1/2, down 16 1/4 cents,
Jan 27 Soybeans  closed at $13.20, down 17 cents,
